description: Surf Coast Shire Drinking Fountains is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Surf Coast Shire Council. Point data containing the location of water drinking fountains within the Surf Coast Shire. This material may be of assistance to you but the Surf Coast Shire does not guarantee that the publication is without flaw of any kind or is wholly appropriate for your particular purposes and therefore disclaims all liability for any error ... Coverage: Surf Coast Shire Council. The portal files it under the publisher Surf Coast Shire Council. Its tags are drinking, playground, tap, walk, water. It offers 7 resource(s) in csv, geojson, shp, tab, wfs. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
